About Me

Background & Interests

I’m Drew, a sophomore mechanical engineering student at CU Boulder pursuing a physics minor. Growing up, I liked building models and LEGO. One Christmas, my dad and I built a four-foot-tall robot kit. I also helped with electrical, plumbing, and carpentry projects around the house, which made hands-on work something I enjoyed early on.

Physics was my favorite subject during my junior and senior years of high school, and I entered college as an engineering physics major. During freshman year, I found that I especially enjoyed CAD and the process of trying, testing, and revising a design. I switched to mechanical engineering for broader career options and more opportunities to design and build physical systems. I kept physics as a minor because I still wanted to study it.

Scouting and leading my Eagle Scout project reinforced how much I enjoy designing and building with other people. I’m interested in automotive engineering, aerospace, clean energy, and applications of physics, though I’m still figuring out which direction I want to pursue. Outside academics, I enjoy cars, backpacking, camping, skiing, and hands-on projects.
